run_descriptor_tests: run the unittest suite for google.protobuf.internal.descriptor to verify descriptor construction and fixups
test_custom_options: test simple and complex custom options on protobuf file, message, field, enum, service, and method descriptors
test_copy_to_proto: test CopyToProto on message, enum, file, and service descriptors to verify proto serialization
test_make_descriptor: test descriptor.MakeDescriptor to build a Descriptor from a DescriptorProto with unsigned int fields
test_aggregate_options: test aggregate options embedded in file, message, field, enum, service, and method descriptors
